title: Surfaces and structure
description: Window chrome, panels, dividers, thumbnails and layout wrappers across the Taskscape screens: title bars, macOS-style window-control discs, surface panels and cards, hairline dividers, attachment tiles and other structural containers. Variant names are my own; component names, looks and behaviours are copied from the rows in rows-structure.json. Where two rows looked alike but differed in a measured or behavioural way, they were kept apart.
